title: Agentic vs. Parametric World Models: Hybrid Planning for Reliable Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.27806v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language agents, such as ReAct, Reflexion, and RAP, implicitly predict how the world will change as they plan and act, using imagined state transitions to guide their decisions. These predictions are encoded in the agents' backbone LLMs as internal beliefs about the environment, effectively forming an implicit world model for multi-step planning. However, hallucinated state information can become embedded in this world model, leading to persistent inaccuracies that influence subsequent decisions. Traditional parametric world models, such as Dreamer and MuZero, learn environment dynamics through explicit transition models, but their limited model capacity makes them difficult to apply directly to modern language-agent planning. We study this tradeoff in graph-structured planning environments and seek to combine the strengths of both paradigms. translated_title: 智能体式世界模型与参数化世界模型：面向可靠语言智能体的混合规划
translated_abstract: 诸如 ReAct、Reflexion 和 RAP 等语言智能体在规划和行动时会隐式地预测世界将如何变化，并利用想象出的状态转移来指导其决策。这些预测以对环境的内部信念的形式编码在智能体的骨干大语言模型（LLM）中，实际上构成了一个用于多步规划的隐式世界模型。然而，幻觉产生的状态信息可能会嵌入到该世界模型中，导致持续存在的不准确性，进而影响后续决策。传统的参数化世界模型（如 Dreamer 和 MuZero）通过显式的转移模型来学习环境动力学，但其有限的模型容量使其难以直接应用于现代语言智能体的规划任务。我们在图结构化的规划环境中研究了这种权衡，并寻求结合两种范式的优势。我们提出了混合世界模型规划（HYBRID-WM），该方法保留了语言智能体的语义……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出混合世界模型规划方法（HYBRID-WM），将语言智能体基于LLM的隐式语义世界模型与传统参数化世界模型的显式动力学建模相结合，以抑制幻觉状态信息、提升多步规划的可靠性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Hybrid World-Model Planning (HYBRID-WM), which combines language agents' implicit LLM-based semantic world models with explicit parametric world models to suppress hallucinated state beliefs and enable more reliable multi-step planning.
